result:
Everything is clean and committed-ready. Work is complete.

## Summary

Built the full `SettingsAdminPage` module per `T-SETTINGS-ADMIN-PAGE-UI`:

- **Page**: `src/pages/SettingsAdminPage.jsx` — Tenant-Admin-only (redirects other roles to the existing `/access-denied` screen), hero banner, 5-tab navigation (User Management, Routing & Approval, Integrations, Notifications, Audit Log), opens on User Management by default (UC11-MF-001).
- **Components** (`src/features/settings-admin/`): `UserManagementTab`, `AddUserForm`, `RoutingApprovalTab`, `AddRuleForm`, `IntegrationsTab` (reuses the pre-existing `IntegrationConnectForm`), `NotificationsTab`, `AuditLogTab`, `AuditLogFilterPanel` — all with loading/empty/error/populated states and no mock data.
- **10 hooks**, **5 service modules**, and a new `settingsAdminSlice` zustand store, wired to the exact `/api/v1/settings/*` endpoints and DTOs from the contract.
- Registered the `/settings/admin` route in `App.jsx`.
- Added `src/__tests__/SettingsAdminPage.test.jsx` (5 cases: default tab, access-denied redirect, duplicate-email blocking, incomplete-rule blocking, read-only audit log).

Verified: lint, full 127-test suite, and production build all pass. Visually checked all five tabs against the TARGET DESIGN images via a local mock backend + Playwright screenshots — close match on layout, labels, and colors.

Noted in `blockers` (in the output JSON): the design's example row values (contract names like "NDA"/"MSA", roles like "VP Legal") don't match the contract's DTO enums (`Product`/`Service`, `Approver`/`Legal Reviewer`/`Tenant Admin`) — I followed the DTO contract, not the design's illustrative values, plus a few other minor inferred-field notes.
